COLDWAR_PAK_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_initialized
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_idea = the_ulema } }
			add_ideas = the_ulema
			set_variable = { the_ulema_opinion = 60 }
			initialize_internal_faction_dynamic_modifiers = yes
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PAK_state_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PAK_economy_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PAK_army_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_PAK_security_modifier }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_general = 1 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_in_seato
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_in_cento
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_in_commonwealth
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_PAK_ladder_feudal_down = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_PAK_ladder_feudal_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_spare_waderas western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes } }
				NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_no_feudal_stepdown_nap neutrality_neutral_social_are_in_power = yes } }
				NOT = { AND = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_no_feudal_stepdown_pml western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_feudal_countryside }
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_feudal_countryside
					add_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_waderas_bend
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_waderas_bend }
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_waderas_bend
					add_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_waderas_endure
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_PAK_allow_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_PAK_allow_elections_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes } }
	}
}

	hidden_effect = {

		else_if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
		else_if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = no } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_PAK_deals_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG_paused } NOT = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_AFG = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG_paused
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AFG } AFG = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_count < 1 } has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG_paused COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_AFG = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border }
		AFG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_open_border_AFG } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER_paused } NOT = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_PER = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER_paused
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PER } PER = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_count < 1 } has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER_paused COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_PER = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_PER_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_quiet_baloch_frontier_count = 1 }

		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works_CHI_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works }
		CHI = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works_CHI } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_taxila_works_CHI } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA_paused } NOT = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_USA = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA_paused
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_count < 1 } has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA_paused COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_USA = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state }
		USA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_frontline_state_USA } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA_paused } NOT = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_LBA = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA_paused
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LBA } LBA = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_count < 1 } has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA_paused COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_LBA = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line }
		LBA = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_tripoli_credit_line_LBA } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI_paused } NOT = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_CHI = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI_paused
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI } CHI = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_count < 1 } has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.104 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI_paused COLDWAR_PAK_deal_clear_CHI = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI_paused
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_count = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord }
		CHI = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.103 days = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
}

COLDWAR_PAK_scars_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = BAN
			NOT = { owns_state = 490 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_PAK_east_released }
			OR = { has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_two_wings has_idea = COLDWAR_PAK_fragile_union }
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PAK.14 days = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_PAK_install_general_yah = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_PAK_general = 1 }
	kill_country_leader = yes
	create_country_leader = {
		name = "Yahya Khan"
		picture = "gfx/Leaders/PAK/PAK_Coldwar_Yahya_Khan.dds"
		ideology = Nat_Autocracy
	}
	COLDWAR_PAK_update_party_programmes = yes
}
